notes: Unified-rule spec (scenario description + the claudecode sibling): the parent's own reply reaches assistant.turn_end while a BACKGROUND subagent keeps running, yet the SESSION stays working, and goes ready only after the last background child drains. Copilot really has this primitive (task tool mode:"background", executionMode "sync"|"background", read_agent/write_agent/list_agents), and the vendor's own SDK type doc confirms the timing: assistant.idle fires 'including while related background work (running agents ...) is still pending and the session-level idle event is therefore deferred'. KNOWN FAILING: irrlichd does NOT hold the parent. hasActiveChildren (session_detector_subagent.go:206-221) reads either metrics.PendingBackgroundAgentCount or a child SessionState, and copilot supplies neither — trackSubagent (copilot/parser.go:382-404) keeps its open-subagent set private and never assigns ev.PendingBackgroundAgentCount, and a copilot subagent writes no session-state/<id>/ directory. So the parent flips working→ready at assistant.turn_end, mid-span, and the held_working phase below is expected RED until that one-line seam is closed. The spec deliberately asserts the CORRECT behaviour, never weakened to match the bug. THREE canonical phases are omitted because they are unreachable by AGENT ARCHITECTURE, not by defect, and could never pass: child_birth (transcript_new for a child), child_link (parent_linked) and child_drain (a child session going working→ready) — there is no child session to observe. Single-birth adapter (agent.FilesUnderRoot + SessionIDFromPath keys the session to its session-state/<id>/ dir), so the birth is one phase anchored to start UNPINNED. duration_at_least_ms on held_working is the invariant window, sized well under the recipe's ~50s background-child span and comfortably over the parent's own end_turn, which lands within a few seconds of the prompt. model is left unpinned (--model accepts only "auto"; the effective model resolves at runtime via session.auto_mode_resolved) and cost is unasserted (gpt-5-mini has no core/pkg/capacity/aliases.go entry) — record fills both from the recording.

text: The copilot parent session appears in ready once session-state/<id>/events.jsonl is written

The dispatch prompt drives the parent ready → working, and the session STAYS working across the detached child's lifetime. The parent's OWN reply finishes within a few seconds (assistant.turn_end fires while the background agent is still running — assistant.idle is emitted with background work pending, only session.idle is deferred), so this window straddles the parent's end_turn: the session must not settle to ready there, nor drop into waiting. THIS IS THE KNOWN-FAILING PHASE — today the parent goes ready at assistant.turn_end because no PendingBackgroundAgentCount signal reaches hasActiveChildren.
Only after the last background child drains (its subagent.completed lands in the parent's events.jsonl) does the parent session transition working → ready
